node.title: Bound sparse circuits selected by a codimension-three quotient plane
node.closure: generalized-MDS completion ceiling, equality-carrier structure, and full-rank deletion double-count
node.statement: For a basepoint-free ten-dimensional V<=F[X]_<13, every rank-ten eleven-set selects one quotient-plane circuit. Three completions of one independent set force every support-at-most-five circuit into a carrier of size at most seven; otherwise every independent set has at most two completions. At m=67485 the resulting per-record cap is 99254447944649683780146155758753837527116020.
